about_the_game:
Christian stepMOTHER ✝️🔥

A linear 2D visual novel that drags you into the suffocating heart of a pastor’s household, where rigid faith masks a storm of corruption, rebellion, and raw desire.

You are the defiant stepson 😈, seething under your father’s iron sermons and your stepmother’s quiet devotion—until she drags you to a shadowy therapist who promises to “fix” you. What begins as forced confession spirals into a relentless descent: every session peels back layers of piety, unleashing corruption that consumes the family from within.

Key Features:

  • Over 2 hours of unbranching, dialogue-driven narrative that never lets up ⏳

  • Beautiful hand-drawn 2D art: every frame drips with expressive characters, sultry close-ups, and atmospheric backgrounds 🎨✝️

  • One inevitable path to a shocking, unforgettable climax 💥

Mature Content Warning: Explicit adult themes, graphic sexual content, psychological manipulation, religious satire, and themes of corruption. Strictly 18+.

content_descriptors.notes: Christian stepMOTHER features on taboo themes and focuses on the breeding and impregnation kink, with some minor BDSM scenes. If you're a very religious person, game is not recommended.
